best_checkpoint_selection.formula: best_potential_weight * near_potential_mae_mm + best_step_weight * near_step_mae_mm + best_direction_weight_mm * near_direction_cosine_error + best_ambiguity_weight_mm * near_ambiguity_mae

notes: These thresholds are provisional PoC gates, not a production guarantee.
branch_ambiguity measures geometric branch competition; input support distance is reported separately as an OOD proxy.
Formal confidence requires unseen-part evaluation across multiple families and seeds.
